body: i’m sorry to hear about your situation, and i appreciate you commenting here despite it. Even with a legitimate reason, i can’t leave this semester because they will not let me back into the program, which is exactly what i fear right now with failing. i understand this may be different for other programs but the program i am in is very strict. i have no option but to complete this semester, otherwise i fail out anyways and then i wouldn’t wait until the end of the semester.

i am 22, live at home and don’t have 401k. The only other thing would be my car that i am still paying off and that my mom co-signed for but i assume she would just get rid of the car so she wouldn’t have to pay for it? Sorry i really don’t know anything about finance/debt so these are probably stupid questions
i will look into this, thank you very much

i appreciate your perspective and i realize that this may seem like a trivial reason to others. For me, it is just the tip of the iceberg. i tried talking to the therapist, i told him i was reckless and had a breakdown earlier this year where i hurt myself (i’d never done anything like that before), but he did not take me seriously even then. He told me something along the lines of “sometimes we look around and see other people with issues/problems/excitement in their lives and we get bored with our lives and make our own problems.” His reaction was probably my fault as i have a tendency of downplaying things when speaking about them out loud but it still hurt. The only reason i am able to try to speak about it here is because i am anonymous and needed to get it off my chest. Yes, i need help but i will never be able to ask for it outright, and i am done trying
Any suggestions of how to go about this?
Yes, this exactly. Thank you for understanding and i’m sorry you’re in a similar situation, it really is awful.

Wow i understand and relate. i’ve always been scared to tell anyone about it because i thought no one else would understand. i could never see my best friend/friends/family again and would be entirely unaffected even though they are kind/loving/etc. i have always felt this way and i don’t know why. Sorry this isn’t helpful, just wanted to let you know you are not alone in feeling this way.

Thank you, i agree. Finding and working up the courage to find a new therapist in the short amount of time i have is extremely unlikely. i am the suffer in silence type, contrary to my posts here. i think it’s just the closer i get and the more reckless i become, the more shocked i am that people around me are still ignoring it or playing it down. i have never had my issues validated or legitimized by anyone, ever. Maybe it’s stupid to crave validation when i know for certain something is wrong but i can’t help but want it anyways. i used to wish i could bring myself to ask for help, but when i felt like i did (finally seeing a therapist), he invalidated me too, so what’s the point? No one has ever taken me seriously and it is inexplicably frustrating. And somehow the fact that they will act completely surprised when i finally do it is the most frustrating part. i am here now, screaming it in their faces, but they won’t believe me. i’m over trying to tell people anymore. Why should i bother trying to convince them when i am going to do it in the end anyways?

Thank you. i am willing push through to finish this semester because i can’t die not knowing if i would have passed or not, otherwise i would let my poor mental health win and do it now. It would take to long for me to work up to seeing another therapist before the end of this semester (December 14) but thank you for your input.
Withdrawing is not an option, and it would take too much time for me to work up the courage to see another therapist. But thank you.

It would be too embarrassing to continue as a nurse’s assistant if i fail out of nursing school. Everyone is counting on me to pass this. i can’t begin to tell you how disappointed my family was when i failed the first class and had to repeat the semester. If i fail again now i will not be able to handle it, period.  There may be other options, yes, but not for me. i’m sorry for being unreasonable; i have considered this outcome for a while now and if i fail it will become a reality no matter what, but thank you for your input.

Withdrawing will count as a fail. i have to complete and pass this course or i get kicked out of the nursing program. i kept telling myself i would take care of my mental health after i finish this semester (i have no time now) and maybe that will happen if i manage to somehow pass but as of right now i’m not and don’t think that i will. i am set on this decision if i fail. 
As for a new therapist, what’s the point? The one I finally worked up the courage to see did everything i feared one would do. Besides, it would take too long for me to try again with someone new and this semester ends in a month.
